Authentic South Indian Vegetarian Restaurant in Brussels

Arya Bhavan is a leading Indian vegetarian restaurant in Brussels, serving authentic South Indian flavours in the heart of the city. Guests searching for crispy dosa near me, South Indian breakfast near me, or traditional South and North Indian thali’s will find all their favourites on our menu.

As a trusted South Indian restaurant vegetarian food lovers recommend, we proudly serve 100% vegetarian dishes made using time-honoured recipes. We also offer specialised vegan restaurant options and Jain and vegan food restaurant selections to meet diverse dietary needs.

Known as a family-friendly Indian vegetarian restaurant in Brussels, we are frequently listed among the top-rated Indian veg restaurants near me and regarded as one of the best dosa restaurants in Brussels.

For celebrations and corporate events, we provide 100% pure vegetarian catering services, including live dosa catering and professional outdoor catering across Belgium.
